title: tephrosia meyeriana
intro: Tephrosia meyeriana, commonly known as the Meyer's bean or African milk, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tephrosia meyeriana include wound healing, pain relief, and the management of various infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
